generated.description: A large gothic-style town hall built mostly from spruce planks, spruce stairs, and stone bricks, with tall pointed spires and a steep central tower rising from a wide stone-brick base. It measures about 51 blocks wide, 51 high, and 48 deep, with roughly 16,600 blocks in total. The interior contains bookshelves, chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, and other functional block entities.
